{{Quote|Hunter killer droid 8-13. Contact established.|Hunter killer droid 8-13, upon firing at Kyle Katarn|<ref name="RAAD" />}}
'''8-13''' was a [[hunter killer droid]] that, by the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], found its way into the irrigation systems of a [[Katarn family compound|homestead]] located on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]. When the homestead was occupied by the [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], 8-13 remained below ground, where it encountered the heir of the homestead, [[Kyle Katarn]], and his [[Farm/Legends|farm]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[WeeGee]]. 8-13 attacked the pair, but focused its attacks on WeeGee when the farm droid closed the distance between them. 8-13 was unable to properly battle the distinctly in-[[Human/Legends|Human]] WeeGee, and the farm droid tore off 8-13's cranial unit.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Target lock disengaged. Switching to close combatance. Transmit signal backup.|8-13, shortly before its destruction|<ref name="RAAD" />}}
8-13<ref name="RAAD" /> was a [[Color/Legends|silver]]-plated<ref name="RA" /> [[hunter killer droid]],<ref name="RAAD" /> a type of [[Battle droid/Legends|war droid]] programmed for fighting against [[Human/Legends|Humans]], with a red and green [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] that inhabited the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]]<ref name="RA" /> during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]].<ref name="TNEC" /> Outdated by this point, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] had been programmed to fight [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. During a melee attack, 8-13 would strike for a Human's vital organs. At some point, the hunter killer droid found its way into the irrigation system underneath the [[Katarn family compound|farm]] of [[Morgan Katarn]], which was under the watch of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the time. While alone in an underground tunnel, it sensed the [[Mission to Sulon|approach]] of Morgan's [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Kyle Katarn]], and the Katarn family droid [[WeeGee]].<ref name="RA" /> When the pair neared, 8-13 activated its [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and fired a [[Laser/Legends|blaster shot]] at Katarn, which missed. WeeGee, in a bid to protect his master, rushed 8-13 and closed the gap between them. As a result, 8-13 deactivated its ranged weapons, and opted to use its melee weapons instead.<ref name="RAAD" /> It was unable to strike any of WeeGee's vital zones, however, as 8-13 attempted to grab at the nonexistent vitals of a Human due to its programming. WeeGee ripped 8-13's head off, removing the war droid as a threat.<ref name="RA" /> Afterwards, WeeGee opinioned that 8-13 must have never encountered a heavy duty [[Farm/Legends|farm]] droid before.<ref name="RAAD" />

==Behind the scenes==
8-13 was first introduced in the [[1998]] novella ''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]'', which was written by [[William C. Dietz]] and illustrated by [[Ezra Tucker]]. Although some detail went into the droid's specifications, it was not given a name in the book.<ref name="RA" /> 8-13 was identified by name, and as a hunter killer droid, in the [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]], which adapted the novella. The droid's voice actor was not credited.<ref name="RAAD" />
